channel.title: Tool Use Cases
channel.description: Which AI tool for which job — for vibe coders and builders. Tool Picks Weekly issues and notable new AI tool releases.

item.title: Tool Picks Weekly #2: Five AI picks you can start for free
item.description: Build, hand off, prototype and run models locally before you pay for anything.

item.title: Tool Picks Weekly #1: Your vibe-coded app can now talk, search and scrape
item.description: Five tools for the jobs that come right after "it works on my screen."

item.title: New: Replit Monitoring Agent
item.description: Replit's Agent can now watch a published app's alerts in the background, investigate production problems and test a fix. You review and publish the fix yourself unless you turn on the experimental Auto-republish setting.

item.title: New: Lovable: creates your Supabase project
item.description: Lovable can now create a Supabase project for an app with no backend and connect it for you. You pick the organization and region (the region can't be changed later), and Supabase bills the project to your own account.

item.title: New: Mistral Voxtral 3
item.description: Mistral's new speech-to-text and text-to-speech models, plus a voice-agent SDK for real-time phone and web agents. Via Mistral's API (EU-hosted option) or self-hosted.

item.title: New: Kling 4.0
item.description: Kuaishou's new video model: clips up to 30 seconds in one pass, steadier fast motion and camera moves, and up to 15 reference assets and 10 keyframes per job.

item.title: New: Meta Muse Spark Open
item.description: Meta's open-weight model for coding and agent work (816B parameters, 42B active, 1M-token context). Meta runs it on two Mac Studios; for most people, hosted APIs are the practical way in.

item.title: New: Claude Haiku 5.5
item.description: Anthropic's cheapest, fastest model, built for high-volume work like support bots, summaries and coding subagents. Anthropic says it costs about 75% less to run than Haiku 4.5.

item.title: New: Nano Banana 2.1 (Google)
item.description: Google's updated image generation and editing model, with better edits, character consistency and text in images. In the Gemini app, AI Studio, the Gemini API, Flow and Stitch.

item.title: New: GitHub Copilot dynamic workflows
item.description: Define multi-agent jobs in code (parallel steps, subagents checking each other, checkpoints where you review) in Copilot CLI, the Copilot app and the Copilot SDK. Public preview, all plans.

item.title: New: HeyGen Video
item.description: HeyGen's first general-purpose video model: 5 to 15-second clips with dialogue and sound generated together, from text, an image or reference media. Available through the HeyGen API.

item.title: New: GPT-6.1 Sol
item.description: OpenAI's DevDay upgrade to GPT-6 Sol, focused on agentic coding, computer use and professional work. OpenAI says it gets close to GPT-6 Astra at a much lower price.

item.title: New: OpenAI Agents API: computer use
item.description: The Agents API can now operate software through computer use, and brings Codex's multi-agent features, tool search and context compaction into your own app. OpenAI runs the infrastructure.

item.title: New: Claude Sonnet 5.5
item.description: Anthropic's faster, cheaper Sonnet, strongest at well-scoped everyday tasks and bug fixes. 30%+ faster than Sonnet 5 at the same $2/$10 per million tokens.

item.title: New: Lovable: free chat
item.description: Chatting with Lovable is now free within a daily allowance: plan features, ask about your app's code and database, or draft launch copy. Building still uses credits.

item.title: New: Cursor Projects
item.description: Beta for big jobs like a feature or a migration: a coordinator agent runs in the cloud, plans the work, hands it to many subagents and keeps shared context over time.
